description: One activation claim per running Claude Code instance: client_key is working prompt X. Claimed by set-status implementing, released at done. SCOPE: non-hook CLI claiming ONLY — it takes no part in file-change attribution, which resolves from claude_session_binding, and FileChangeAdd carries no client_key field at all, so the two ladders have no row to disagree about. A registry, never a single session pointer — several prompts are routinely active on one session concurrently.
